title: Audio Capture
description: Settings for the audio capture extension.

autoConnect.title: Auto-connect on startup
autoConnect.description: Start microphone capture automatically when JupyterLab loads. Off by default - capture normally begins only when you click the status-bar microphone.

toolbar.title: Audio status toolbar items
toolbar.description: Items in the status-bar audio pill, right of the microphone. Other extensions add them through "jupyter.lab.toolbars" -> "AudioStatus" in their own settings schema. To hide an item, copy it to User Preferences and add "disabled": true.

disabled.title: Whether the item is ignored or not

icon.title: Item icon id
icon.description: If defined, it will override the command icon

label.title: Item label
label.description: If defined, it will override the command label

caption.title: Item caption
caption.description: If defined, it will override the command caption
